_provenance.description: Calibration constants for the lipid-oxidation hydroperoxide kinetics in src/lipid_oxidation.py. Externalized 2026-06-22 (S27 Workstream A) from previously hardcoded magic numbers so the kinetics can be recalibrated without code edits.
_provenance.kinetics_source: Frankel (1998) radical-chain framing; Arrhenius prefactor/Ea are order-of-magnitude literature values, NOT a fitted barrier. The absolute observable scale is pinned downstream by the per-(matrix, process_state) calibration registry, so these constants set the SHAPE of the temperature/time response, not the final ppb.
_provenance.saturation_rationale: max_conversion_fraction (when set to a number) caps the first-order oxidation extent via conversion = c*(1-exp(-progress/c)), linear when progress << c. EMPIRICAL FINDING (2026-06-22): the validated benchmark envelope reaches progress ~= 0.06 (100C/45min) and the external hold-out failures sit in the SAME progress regime (HME ~0.07), so a cap aggressive enough to bend the hold-out also perturbs in-panel trace points (Hexanal/Nonanal ~2e-4 ppb with near-zero-width Monte-Carlo CIs) and regressed the headline 37/48 -> 31/48 even at c=12. The hold-out over-prediction is therefore a per-(matrix, process_state) CALIBRATION gap (owned by Workstream B: process-state-aware uncertainty + curation), NOT a kinetic-shape problem. The cap is therefore SHIPPED DISABLED (null): predict_hexanal_generation/predict_lop_generation are byte-identical to the pre-S27 linear model by default, so the headline stays 37/48. The mechanism + _saturated_extent are retained, unit-tested, and ready to be re-enabled alongside the Workstream-B CI re-sizing.
_provenance.do_not_invent_numbers: Branching ratios and lipid profiles are literature-typical values already present in the codebase prior to this change; they were moved here verbatim. Refit only against real measured_volatiles via scripts/calibrate_lipid_oxidation.py.

formulation_path.comment: Used by predict_lop_generation: proxy LOP loads injected into the recommend engine (initial_concentrations).

hexanal_path.comment: Used by predict_hexanal_generation for its named secondary-product outputs. Note: the matrix-benchmark path consumes only total_hydroperoxide and applies MATRIX_BENCHMARK_BASE_MARKER_YIELDS separately, so these named ratios do not drive matrix-only ppb.
